images.prompt: Full-bleed square brand logo illustration in Southern-gothic engraved styling. A white goateed colonel silhouette in profile, set inside a bucket-shaped cameo with a fine engraved scalloped border, centred on a field of bold crimson-red and cream vertical stripes running top to bottom across the whole canvas. Full-bleed square: the background colour fills the entire canvas edge to edge. No card, no frame, no rounded container, no drop shadow, no surrounding margin or border. The only text anywhere in the image is exactly: CLUCKINGHAM, set in a condensed engraved serif across the lower third in cream. Nothing else is written anywhere in the image.

Cinematic wide establishing shot at dusk of a roadside fried-chicken compound on a rural highway. A long red-and-white vertically striped awning runs across a low cinderblock building; an oversized bucket-shaped sign, completely blank and unlettered with only red and white vertical stripes on it, stands on a steel lattice pole above the roofline; thick fryer steam vents from two roof stacks and drifts across the deep blue sky; a wet gravel lot with shallow puddles reflecting a single flickering plain neon tube glowing inside the front window; warm tungsten light spilling through the glass, heavy atmospheric haze, rich shadow. Anamorphic 35mm, low angle, cinematic contrast, film grain. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. CRITICAL: absolutely no writing anywhere in the image, no letters, no words, no signage text, no lettering on the bucket sign, no logos, no hands, no people.
